author: Danielle Gutierrez
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bsu5ney6

steps.title: Configure MaxQuant Search Parameters
steps.instruction: Search label-free proteomic samples using MaxQuant version 1.6.17 with the following group-specific and global parameter settings.

substeps.instruction: Configure Variable modifications: Oxidation (M), Acetylation (Protein N-term), and Carbamidomethyl (C).
Set Max number of modifications per peptide to 5.
Set Instrument settings to Orbitrap (default settings).
Set Digestion to Specific, Trypsin /P with Max missed cleavages of 2.
Select Database: UniProt Human Proteome (UP000005640, 9606) Reviewed, downloaded July 30, 2019.
Set Min peptide length to 7 and Max peptide mass to 4600 Da.
Set MS/MS analyzer and Identification to Default settings.
